refnamediv.refpurpose: Compute the periodogram power spectral density estimate.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [Pxx, f] = periodogram(x) [Pxx, f] = periodogram(x, win) [Pxx, f] = periodogram(x, win, nfft) [Pxx, f] = periodogram(x, win, nfft, fs) [Pxx, f] = periodogram(x, win, nfft, fs, range)

listitem.para: (optional) Window applied to the signal. If empty or unspecified, a rectangular window is used.
(optional) Number of frequency bins. Default is 256 or the next power of 2 greater than the length of `x`.
(optional) Spectrum range. Options are "onesided" (default for real signals), "twosided", or "centered".

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `periodogram` function computes the power spectral density (PSD) of a signal using the periodogram method. It supports various configurations for windowing, FFT length, sampling rate, and spectrum range.
